methods.responses: scripts 13-15 ported (within transformation, harvest-year clusters, Paule-Mandel, empirical Bayes; best = regional-v1 rule)
methods.hindcast: rolling origin, target +-1 year excluded, training from 1981, leads 8..0, methods ['trend', 'index_perfect', 'index_todate', 'weather_todate']; weather for staple panels
methods.predictions: index_outlook (CPC quantiles / sigma ratio, 2015-16 shape), index_todate, weather_todate; production weights of the paper

scope: The six staple crop families of the analysis layer (maize, rice, wheat, soybean, sorghum, cassava); every series of the release database in those families

views.record: observed yields of every unit and series with the fitted trend and anomalies (database observations; trend_series, trend_anomaly)
views.response: the ENSO response at unit, state and country level (response_unit, response_region, response_country)
views.season: the current season: scenario index paths, index outlook scenarios, the weather-to-date estimate with its gates, the season-to-date weather anomalies against the index-expected ones, panel status, and the hindcast skill by lead (prediction_*, scenario_index_path, weather_todate_anomaly*, evaluation_skill)
